mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_ingestion SET status = 'PROCESSING', stage = CASE WHEN prepared_key IS NULL THEN 'PREPARING' ELSE 'PUBLISHING' END, lease_owner = #{worker}, lease_epoch = lease_epoch + 1, lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{lease}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, revision = revision + 1, error_code = NULL, retryable = FALSE, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE job_id = #{row.jobId} AND tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND owner_id = #{row.ownerId} AND lease_epoch = #{row.leaseEpoch} AND (status = 'RECEIVED' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))

UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = #{state}, published_version = version, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id = #{caller.tenantId} AND owner_id = #{caller.userId} AND document_id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND ingestion_job_id = #{jobId} AND status <> 'READY'

UPDATE knowledge_ingestion SET status = 'RECEIVED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_code = NULL, retryable = FALSE, attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{delay}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE AND revision = #{revision} AND status = 'FAILED' AND retryable = TRUE AND retry_count < #{maximum}

mapper.sql: SELECT c.document_id, c.document_version AS version, c.chunk_id, c.batch_digest, c.text, c.start_byte, c.end_byte, d.display_name FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.document_id = c.document_id AND d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.owner_id = c.owner_id JOIN knowledge_ingestion j ON j.job_id = c.job_id AND j.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND j.owner_id = c.owner_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{caller.tenantId} AND c.owner_id = #{caller.userId} AND d.status = 'READY' AND d.published_version = c.document_version AND d.version = c.document_version AND d.ingestion_job_id = j.job_id AND j.status = 'READY' AND j.batch_digest = c.batch_digest
